notices.title: Advance notice of fee increases
notices.aiSummary: Banks and credit unions must give consumers at least 60 days' written notice before increasing fees on deposit accounts. Firms must comply starting March 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to banks that offer deposit accounts to consumers, and Brivanta Bank offers consumer checking and savings accounts.

notices.title: Notifying customers of payment outages
notices.aiSummary: Payment service providers serving consumers must post a notice in their app and on their website within 1 hour of any outage that prevents customers from making payments. Firms must comply starting February 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to payment service providers serving consumers, and Brivanta Bank offers instant account-to-account payments, consumer checking and savings with associated payment functions, and debit/credit cards.
aiProducts: instant account-to-account payments in mobile app

notices.title: Limits on debt collection contacts
notices.aiSummary: The Retail Conduct Authority proposes limiting debt collection calls to 7 times in 7 days per debt and requiring firms to honor consumer requests for written-only contact. This is a consultation open for comments until January 15, 2027, with proposed effectiveness on June 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: This notice applies to firms that collect consumer debts including debts they originated, and Brivanta Bank collects its own consumer debts.

notices.title: Reporting significant cyber incidents
notices.aiSummary: Deposit-taking institutions must report significant cyber incidents to the Prudential Banking Board within 24 hours and submit a final incident report within 30 days after resolution. Firms must comply starting March 31, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to deposit-taking institutions, and Brivanta Bank offers consumer checking and savings accounts as well as small business deposit accounts, making it a deposit-taking institution subject to this rule.

notices.title: Sanctions list updates
notices.aiSummary: Firms must screen their entire customer base against each sanctions list update within 24 hours of publication. This requirement becomes effective on December 15, 2026.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to all firms subject to sanctions screening obligations, and Brivanta Bank as a retail and small-business bank with deposit accounts and lending products is subject to such obligations under anti-money laundering requirements.
aiProducts: small business loans and deposit accounts

notices.title: Mortgage arrears and forbearance
notices.aiSummary: Firms that lend or service residential mortgages must contact borrowers within 15 days of a missed payment and offer forbearance options before repossession. Compliance is required from February 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to firms that lend or service residential mortgages, and Brivanta Bank originates and services residential mortgages.

notices.title: Records of marketing consent
notices.feed: Financial Data Protection Office publications feed
notices.aiSummary: Firms that send electronic marketing must keep records of when and how each customer gave consent and must stop sending electronic marketing within 10 days of consent withdrawal. These requirements become effective on January 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: This notice applies to any firm that sends electronic marketing to individuals, and Brivanta Bank sends electronic marketing according to its profile.

notices.title: Accessible communications
notices.aiSummary: Firms must offer statements and important notices in large print, braille, or screen-reader friendly formats on request at no extra cost. Compliance is required by February 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to all firms that send statements and notices to retail customers, and Brivanta Bank sends statements and notices for its consumer deposit accounts, loans, mortgages, and card products.

notices.title: Best execution reporting for equity orders
notices.aiSummary: Broker-dealers must publish quarterly reports on equity order routing venues and execution quality. Compliance is required from April 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: This notice applies only to registered broker-dealers that route customer equity orders, and Brivanta Bank does not operate a broker-dealer or route securities orders.

notices.title: Annuity suitability assessments
notices.aiSummary: Insurers and insurance intermediaries must complete written suitability assessments before recommending annuities and disclose surrender charges and periods before contract signing. Compliance is required from March 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: This notice applies only to insurers and insurance intermediaries that sell or recommend annuities, and Brivanta Bank does not sell or recommend insurance or annuities.

notices.title: Liquidity stress testing
notices.aiSummary: Deposit-taking institutions with over 1 billion in assets must run monthly liquidity stress tests including rapid digital deposit outflow scenarios and hold enough liquid assets to cover 30 days of net outflows under their most severe scenario. Compliance is required by March 31, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to deposit-taking institutions with more than 1 billion in total assets, and Brivanta Bank is a deposit-taking institution with 18 billion in total assets.

notices.title: Fraud monitoring for instant payments
notices.aiSummary: Firms that send instant payments must implement real-time fraud screening before releasing payments and provide 24/7 fraud reporting channels for customers. Compliance is required by April 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to payment service providers that send instant payments, and Brivanta Bank offers instant account-to-account payments in its mobile app.

notices.title: Credit card minimum payment warnings
notices.aiSummary: Card issuers must display on each monthly statement the time needed to repay the balance by making only minimum payments and the total interest cost. Compliance is required by May 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to card issuers that offer revolving credit cards to consumers, and Brivanta Bank offers credit cards to its customers.

notices.title: Suspicious activity reporting timeliness
notices.aiSummary: Firms must file suspicious activity reports within 30 calendar days of detection and report SAR volumes and timeliness to the board at least quarterly. These requirements become effective on January 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to all firms subject to anti-money laundering obligations, and Brivanta Bank as a retail and small-business bank with deposit accounts, lending, and payment services is subject to AML requirements.

notices.title: Third-party AI models in credit decisions
notices.aiSummary: Lenders using third-party AI models in consumer credit decisions must maintain an inventory of those models and have their model risk committee review each one at least annually for performance and fairness. Compliance is required by June 30, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to lenders using third-party AI models for consumer credit decisions, and Brivanta Bank offers multiple credit products where such models could be used for approval, decline, or pricing decisions.

notices.title: Customers in vulnerable circumstances
notices.aiSummary: Firms must record customer vulnerabilities with consent and train customer-facing staff annually to recognize and respond to vulnerability signs. Compliance is required by February 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to all firms that serve retail customers, and Brivanta Bank serves retail customers through its consumer banking, lending, mortgage, small business, and payment services.
aiProducts: small business loans and deposit accounts

notices.title: Managing critical third parties
notices.aiSummary: Deposit-taking institutions must maintain a register of critical third parties, tested exit plans, and annual reviews for outsourced or cloud services supporting important business functions. Compliance is required by March 31, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to deposit-taking institutions that rely on outsourced or cloud services for important business services, and Brivanta Bank is a deposit-taking institution that likely uses third-party technology providers for its digital banking, payment systems, and other operational services.
aiProducts: small business loans and deposit accounts

notices.title: Personal data breach notification
notices.feed: Financial Data Protection Office publications feed
notices.aiSummary: Firms must notify the Financial Data Protection Office within 72 hours of discovering a personal data breach and must promptly notify affected customers when the breach poses high risk to them. These requirements take effect on January 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: This notice applies to any firm that holds personal data about retail customers, and Brivanta Bank holds personal data for its consumer and small business customers across all its deposit, lending, and payment products.

notices.title: Keeping complaint records
notices.aiSummary: Firms must retain all complaint records and correspondence for at least 7 years from the final response and provide them to the Authority within 10 business days of a request. Compliance is required by 2027-01-15.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to all firms that handle complaints from retail customers, and Brivanta Bank handles retail customer complaints across its consumer and small-business banking products.

notices.title: Reimbursement for authorized push payment scams
notices.aiSummary: From April 1, 2027, the firm must reimburse eligible scam victims within 5 business days unless there is evidence of gross negligence or fraud, and must implement payee name-matching checks with warnings for first-time payments to new payees. These requirements apply to the firm's instant account-to-account payment service offered through its mobile app.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to payment service providers that send instant or same-day account-to-account payments for consumers, and Brivanta Bank offers instant account-to-account payments in its mobile app.
aiProducts: instant account-to-account payments in mobile app

notices.title: Beneficial ownership for business customers
notices.aiSummary: Banks must identify and verify individuals owning 25% or more of business customers before opening accounts, and refresh this information annually for high-risk business customers. Compliance is required by January 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to banks that open accounts for companies, partnerships and other legal entities, and Brivanta Bank offers small business loans and deposit accounts.

notices.title: Complaint handling timelines
notices.aiSummary: Firms must acknowledge complaints within 2 business days and send a final response within 15 business days (reduced from 30 calendar days), and analyze complaint root causes quarterly. These requirements take effect on January 15, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to all firms that handle complaints from retail customers about banking, lending or payment products, and Brivanta Bank offers all three categories of products to retail and small-business customers.

notices.title: Operational resilience of important business services
notices.aiSummary: Brivanta Bank must identify important business services, set impact tolerances for maximum tolerable disruption, conduct annual testing through severe scenario exercises, and obtain board approval of the list and tolerances. Compliance is required by March 31, 2027.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to deposit-taking institutions with more than 1 billion in total assets, and Brivanta Bank is a deposit-taking institution with 18 billion in total assets.

notices.title: Responding to customer data access requests
notices.feed: Financial Data Protection Office publications feed
notices.aiSummary: Firms must respond to customer data access requests within 30 days and maintain a log of all requests including dates and outcomes. Compliance is required starting December 1, 2026.
notices.aiReason: The notice applies to any firm that holds personal data about retail customers, and Brivanta Bank holds personal data for its consumer and small business customers across all its deposit, lending, and payment products.

notices.title: Overdraft fee transparency
notices.aiSummary: Banks offering overdraft services must show consumers the fee amount and allow transaction cancellation before charging overdraft fees on card or app transactions, and must send monthly summaries of all overdraft and returned-item fees. Compliance is required by February 1, 2027.
notices.aiReason: This rule applies to banks that offer deposit accounts with an overdraft service to consumers, and Brivanta Bank offers consumer checking and savings accounts with an overdraft service.
aiProducts: consumer checking and savings accounts with overdraft service
